CustomField.description: TNCI-206 / ELV-DM-010. Converted from writable Checkbox to Formula Checkbox. TRUE when the line is active on the quote Day 1 ARR start date: non-renewal lines must start exactly on that date, renewal lines need only span it. Summary Items are excluded so the flag can gate Day 1 ARR aggregation without double counting. Reads ELV_Day_1_ARR_Start_Date__c, itself a cross-object formula to the Quote cascade.
CustomField.formula: AND( NOT( ISPICKVAL( Ruby__LineType__c, "SummaryItem" ) ), OR( AND( NOT( CONTAINS( TEXT( Ruby__ChangeType__c ), "Renew" ) ), Ruby__SubscriptionStartDate__c = ELV_Day_1_ARR_Start_Date__c ), AND( Ruby__SubscriptionStartDate__c <= ELV_Day_1_ARR_Start_Date__c, ELV_End_Date__c >= ELV_Day_1_ARR_Start_Date__c ) ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Checked when this line contributes to Day 1 ARR. Summary Items are always unchecked.
CustomField.label: Include in Day 1 ARR
